title: Planting Motion Plan
medium: Inkjet Print on Cotton Rag Inkjet Coated Paper

events.n: print based on a drone photograph of the Orozco Garden at the South London Gallery
events.q: The starting point for Orozco’s print is a photograph shot from a drone overflying the Orozco Garden at the South London Gallery that opened to the public in October 2016.
The picture was taken in 2021, five years after the Garden was built and planted.

events.n: published in the fundraising portfolio for the gallery's 130th anniversary
events.q:
SLG130 Portfolio
A fundraising portfolio of limited edition prints by five leading international artists, which has been created to mark the 130th anniversary of the South London Gallery (SLG).
